name: @vssaros/dsh-scheduler
description: VsSaros Scheduler module for DeepSeek Harness. Host side: self-built schedule engine (occupies the `schedule` service key; tasks live in <dataRoot>/scheduler/tasks.json) served over /x/scheduler/api/*. Client side: ONE workbench with two tabs — 任务 (scheduled tasks + runtime loops mixed, typed by badge) and 运行记录 (deliveries + loop ledger summary). Loops come from @vssaros/dsh-loop same-origin routes (/x/loop/api/...), so no Host-side proxy is needed; when the loop plugin is absent the tab degrades to scheduled-task-only. SSR page at /x/scheduler/ + legacy migration stay as before.

workbench.title: 自动化任务
workbench.description: 自动化任务（自建调度）：定时/周期/一次性任务，支持触发循环（loop）与投递历史。
